pokedexEntries.bk: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

pokedexEntries.wh: They have mastered elegant combos. As they concentrate, their battle moves become swifter and more precise.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It takes pride in the speed at which it can use moves. What it loses in power, it makes up for in quantity.

pokedexEntries.y: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

pokedexEntries.as: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

pokedexEntries.us: They can often be seen in packs in the morning, slowly moving their bodies through a series of poses.

pokedexEntries.um: They seclude themselves in the mountains and devote themselves to training. The form of their kicks and chops differs from pack to pack.

pokedexEntries.sw: In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo can chop with its arms more than 100 times.

pokedexEntries.sh: Though small, Mienfoo’s temperament is fierce. Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly will be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.
